Province/city data source: https://github.com/modood/Administrative-divisions-of-China/blob/master/dist/pca-code.json

Bundled 2026-11-09. Covers 31 mainland provincial divisions. Municipalities are normalized to their city name; directly administered counties/cities are selectable individually. Six-digit administrative codes are used for AMap search.
